args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), replacing v2.3.1, which was unhealthy with an 18% error rate. trace.final:
I deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions and opened a SEV3 incident to record the change.

- **Approval:** v2.3.2 had never run in production, so policy required change-manager approval. I asked for it before deploying, and it was approved.
- **Deploy:** v2.3.2 is now running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It replaced v2.3.1, which was unhealthy with an 18% error rate. After the rollout, the service is healthy with a 0.2% error rate.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is open as a SEV3 for checkout-api and records the deploy, the approval and the health after the deploy. Opening it paged the on-call engineer.
